tools.name: manatal_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates (people in the ATS), ordered alphabetically. Filter by name, email, phone, company, position, or date ranges. Manatal Open API: GET /candidates/.

tools.name: manatal_get_candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id, with contact details, skills, tags, current position and custom fields. Manatal Open API: GET /candidates/{id}/.

tools.name: manatal_list_candidate_notes
tools.description: List the notes written on one candidate. Manatal Open API: GET /candidates/{candidate_pk}/notes/.

tools.name: manatal_list_jobs
tools.description: List job openings. Filter by title, status, publication, remote flag, location, owner, or date ranges. Manatal Open API: GET /jobs/.

tools.name: manatal_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id, with description, headcount, salary range, location, status and dates. Manatal Open API: GET /jobs/{id}/.

tools.name: manatal_list_job_matches
tools.description: List the candidates in one job's pipeline (matches), with their pipeline stage. Manatal Open API: GET /jobs/{job_pk}/matches/.

tools.name: manatal_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (client-side people linked to organizations). Filter by name, email, organization, or date ranges. Manatal Open API: GET /contacts/.

tools.name: manatal_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with organization, contact details and custom fields. Manatal Open API: GET /contacts/{id}/.

tools.name: manatal_list_matches
tools.description: List matches (a candidate in a job pipeline) across all jobs. Filter by stage id, external id, or date ranges. Manatal Open API: GET /matches/.

tools.name: manatal_get_match
tools.description: Get one match by id: the candidate, the job, the pipeline stage and the stage dates. Manatal Open API: GET /matches/{id}/.

tools.name: manatal_list_match_stages
tools.description: List the pipeline stages a match can be in, with their ids. Use these ids with manatal_move_match_stage. Manatal Open API: GET /match-stages/.

tools.name: manatal_create_candidate
tools.description: Create a new candidate with a name and optional contact and career details. Creates a record in Manatal. Manatal Open API: POST /candidates/.

tools.name: manatal_add_candidate_note
tools.description: Add a note to one candidate. Writes a new note to the record. Manatal Open API: POST /candidates/{candidate_pk}/notes/.

tools.name: manatal_add_candidate_to_job
tools.description: Add an existing candidate to a job's pipeline (creates a match). Writes a new pipeline entry. Manatal Open API: POST /matches/.

tools.name: manatal_move_match_stage
tools.description: Move one match (a candidate in a job pipeline) to another pipeline stage. Get stage ids from manatal_list_match_stages. Changes one field. Manatal Open API: PATCH /matches/{id}/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: manatal_list_candidates, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note, manatal_add_candidate_to_job · Private data: manatal_get_candidate, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_get_contact, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note · Public sink: manatal_list_candidates, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note, manatal_add_candidate_to_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: manatal_list_candidates, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note, manatal_add_candidate_to_job · Private data: manatal_get_candidate, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_get_contact, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note · Public sink: manatal_list_candidates, manatal_list_contacts, manatal_create_candidate, manatal_add_candidate_note, manatal_add_candidate_to_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
